BODY_INERTIAL.description: Non-rotating axes aligned with the reference body's equator and prime meridian at the reference epoch.

OBJECT_REFERENCED.description: Axes built from the relative geometry of two named objects; see RFMObjectReferencedAxes.

LOCAL_ALIGNED_CONSTRAINED.description: Axes built by aligning one vector and constraining a second; see RFMLocalAlignedConstrainedAxes.

BODY_EQUATOR.description: Axes in the reference body's equatorial plane at the requested epoch.

SOLAR_ECLIPTIC_MAGNETOSPHERIC.description: Solar-ecliptic magnetospheric axes: X toward the Sun, Z along the ecliptic north, commonly abbreviated GSE.

SOLAR_MAGNETOSPHERIC.description: Solar-magnetospheric axes: X toward the Sun, Z in the plane containing the body magnetic dipole, commonly abbreviated GSM.

TOPOCENTRIC.description: Local horizon axes at a surface site; the site is carried on RFMOrigin.

BODY_SPIN_SUN.description: Axes fixed by the body spin axis and the body-to-Sun direction.

EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED.description: Axes defined by a loaded ephemeris/orientation kernel; identified by KERNEL_FRAME_NAME / KERNEL_FRAME_ID on RFMCoordinateSystem.

MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.description: LEGACY, retained and NAMED rather than left implicit: mean equator of date computed with the IAU-76/FK5 precession theory instead of the IAU-2006/2000A chain. Results differ from MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR at the milliarcsecond level and the two are not interchangeable.

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.description: LEGACY, retained and NAMED: true equator of date computed with the IAU-76/FK5 precession-nutation theory. See MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_IERS1996.description: True equator of date computed with the IERS Conventions (1996) reduction (IERS Technical Note 21): IAU 1976 precession, IAU 1980 nutation with the observed celestial pole offsets applied. Distinct from TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5 (no offsets) and TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR (IAU-2006/2000A).

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_IERS2003.description: True equator of date computed with the IERS Conventions (2003) reduction (IERS Technical Note 32): IAU 2000A nutation on the IAU 1976 precession with the IAU 2000 precession-rate corrections. The mean-of-date equator under this reduction is MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.

TOPOCENTRIC_EAST_NORTH_UP.description: Topocentric East-North-Up axes at a surface site; the site is carried on RFMOrigin. TOPOCENTRIC (20) does not fix the axis order; this does.

TOPOCENTRIC_NORTH_EAST_DOWN.description: Topocentric North-East-Down axes at a surface site.

TOPOCENTRIC_SOUTH_EAST_ZENITH.description: Topocentric South-East-Zenith axes at a surface site.

ORBITAL_VELOCITY_NORMAL_CONORMAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: X along the velocity, Z along the orbit normal, Y completing the right-handed set (VNC). The object is the origin body of the coordinate system.

ORBITAL_RADIAL_TRANSVERSE_NORMAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: X radial (outward), Z along the orbit normal, Y transverse completing the set (RTN, also RSW).

ORBITAL_LOCAL_VERTICAL_LOCAL_HORIZONTAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: Z toward the central body (nadir), Y opposite the orbit normal, X completing the set (LVLH).

GALACTIC.description: IAU 1958 Galactic longitude/latitude axes, Hipparcos realization: NGP RA = 192.85948 deg, Dec = +27.12825 deg; l_Omega = 32.93192 deg. ESA SP-1200 (1997), Vol. 1, Section 1.5.3. Cartesian X points to l=0,b=0, Y to l=90,b=0, Z to the north Galactic pole (right-handed). This fixes orientation only, not the origin or the direction of Sgr A*. Explicit Galactocentric parameters select the derived orientation documented on ROLL_DEG; choosing an origin alone never rotates the axes. See Liu, Zhu & Zhang (2011), A&A 526, A16, on the definition and its realization in ICRS; do not substitute a newly fitted Galactic plane.

CELESTIAL_BODY.description: The centre of mass of a single celestial body.

BARYCENTRE.description: The barycentre of a named system of bodies.

LIBRATION_POINT.description: A libration (Lagrange) point of a two-body system.

SPACE_OBJECT.description: Another tracked space object, identified by OBJECT_ID.

GROUND_SITE.description: A fixed site on a body surface, identified by SITE_ID and the geodetic fields on RFMOrigin.

GALACTIC_CENTER.description: Galactic center at Sgr A*. Its ICRS direction, solar distance, height, roll and velocity are explicit parameters on RFMCoordinateSystem. No ephemeris body code is implied by this origin.

ORBIT_NORMAL.description: Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.

COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS.description: Compute access windows from pre-sampled target Cartesian states.

SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS.description: Simulate sensor observations of TARGETS by SENSORS: schedule tracks inside the ACCESS windows (computed per sensor and target by COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS with that sensor's constraints), generate each measurement from the truth states with its MEMErrorModel noise and bias, apply the detection test, and add false alarms. The observations are emitted as separate $RDO (RADAR), $EOO (OPTICAL, LASER_RANGING) and $RFO (PASSIVE_RF) records; the result lists the tracks.

COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS_EXPLICIT_BODY.description: Only runtime access operation in body-aware modules; CENTRAL_BODY required.

SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS_EXPLICIT_BODY.description: Only runtime simulation operation in body-aware modules; body required.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite, or numerically invalid.

UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.description: The requested operation is not supported by the module.

MIN_ELEVATION.description: Observer-to-target elevation at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (ground observers).

MAX_RANGE.description: Observer-to-target range at or below MAX_RANGE_M.

MIN_RANGE.description: Observer-to-target range at or above MIN_RANGE_M.

SUN_EXCLUSION.description: Angle between the observer-to-target and observer-to-Sun directions at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (solar exclusion).

MOON_EXCLUSION.description: Angle between the observer-to-target and observer-to-Moon directions at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (lunar exclusion).

LINE_OF_SIGHT.description: Straight-line visibility between observer and target not occulted by the central body raised by OCCULTATION_ATMOSPHERE_HEIGHT_M (satellite-to-satellite).

ANY_OF.description: At least one member must hold (OR).

DISCRETE.description: Evaluate at the supplied sample epochs only; window edges are samples.

CONTINUOUS.description: Bracket between samples and refine each edge to ROOT_TOLERANCE_S.

RADAR.description: Monostatic radar: range, range rate, two-way Doppler, azimuth, elevation.

OPTICAL.description: Passive optical: right ascension and declination, magnitude.

PASSIVE_RF.description: Passive RF: angles and the received (one-way) frequency of a target's emitter.

MEMErrorModel.description:
Noise, bias and editing rules for one observable. Standard deviations and
biases use the observable's SI unit. ANGLE observables use radians.

MEMEditingDecision.description:
One deterministic editing decision. The observation identity is carried
from the tracking-data input so rejected sets can be compared exactly.

MEMAttestation.description:
Dual-form signature. Presence means both signatures are required and both
MUST verify independently; an invalid member rejects the record rather
than downgrading it to unsigned.

MEM.description:
Measurement Error Model. JSON projections preserve these IDL-capitalized
field names exactly. The FlatBuffer signature covers the size-prefixed
buffer with both signature vectors zeroed; the canonical-JSON signature
covers RFC 8785 canonical JSON with both signature fields omitted.

SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

Ephemeris.description: Ephemerides: states over time, from an operator or a precise-orbit service

Observation.description: Observations (ranges, angles, other measurements) that states are estimated from

Reference.description: Reference registers of sites and facilities (status, dates, identity)

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

Unspecified.description: Not stated. Never a grant: treated as CiteOnly.

Reproducible.description: The records may be republished, with the credit the terms ask.

CiteOnly.description: The records are computed on and cited, never republished.

ShareAlike.description: The records may be republished under the same terms, which every derived record carries.

NonCommercial.description: The records may be republished for non-commercial use only.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

SOURCE_URL.description:
Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material as it
was retrieved (the SOURCE_URL of $CMR and $AVL).

SOURCE_VERSION.description:
Source revision, edition or upstream update marker verbatim: for a file
its originator stamps, the stamp.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond time the source material was retrieved.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes as retrieved, 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. Empty when the source cannot expose replayable
bytes.

SOURCE_BYTES.description:
Number of source bytes SOURCE_SHA256 covers: the length of the prefix when
the source was fetched by range. 0 when not stated.

PRODUCER_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the build of PRODUCER that made the product (its dist
module.wasm), 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Stamped by the host
that loaded the producing module: a module cannot hash its own bytes.
Empty when not stated.

MJD.description: Modified Julian Date in UTC, e.g., 58119

X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS.description: x component of Pole Wander in radians, e.g., 2.872908911518888E-7

Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS.description: y component of Pole Wander in radians, e.g., 1.2003259523750447E-6

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS.description: x component of Celestial Pole Offset in radians, e.g., 5.720801437092525E-10

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS.description: y component of Celestial Pole Offset in radians, e.g., -8.484239419416879E-10

UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: UT1 minus UTC in seconds, e.g., 0.2163567

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: TAI minus UTC in seconds, e.g., 37

LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS.description: Correction to Length of Day in seconds, e.g., 8.094E-4

SERIES.description:
Published series this row was taken from. Rows from different series are
NOT interchangeable at the microarcsecond level and must not be merged
without recording which series each row came from.

IERS_C04_14.description: IERS EOP 14 C04, the long-term combined solution (e.g. eopc04_14_IAU2000.62-now.txt).

IERS_C04_20.description: IERS EOP 20 C04, the ITRF2020-based combined solution.

IERS_BULLETIN_A.description: IERS Bulletin A rapid service / prediction.

FINALS2000A.description: USNO/IERS finals2000A combined rapid + prediction file.

OTHER.description: A series not covered above; identify it in a producer-defined way.

IAU_CONVENTION.description:
Precession-nutation model the celestial pole offsets are expressed
against. X_/Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS are CIP offsets in the GCRS
(dX, dY) under the IAU 2000/2006 conventions; a consumer cannot apply
them correctly without knowing which model produced them.

X_POLE_WANDER_UNCERTAINTY_RADIANS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in x Pole Wander, radians.

Y_POLE_WANDER_UNCERTAINTY_RADIANS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in y Pole Wander, radians.

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_UNCERTAINTY_RADI.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the x Celestial Pole Offset, radians.

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_UNCERTAINTY_RADI.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the y Celestial Pole Offset, radians.

UT1_MINUS_UTC_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in UT1 minus UTC, seconds.

LENGTH_OF_DAY_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the Length of Day correction, seconds.

X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS_HP.description:
x component of Pole Wander in radians, double precision. Authoritative
over X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS when present.

Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS_HP.description:
y component of Pole Wander in radians, double precision. Authoritative
over Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS when present.

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS_HP.description:
x component of the Celestial Pole Offset in radians, double precision.
Authoritative over X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS when present.

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS_HP.description:
y component of the Celestial Pole Offset in radians, double precision.
Authoritative over Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS when present.

UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS_HP.description:
UT1 minus UTC in seconds, double precision. Authoritative over
UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS when present.

LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS_HP.description:
Correction to Length of Day in seconds, double precision. Authoritative
over LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS when present.

DATA_SET_EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the data set this row was published in, ISO 8601 UTC. Identifies
WHICH issue of the series a consumer is holding; two rows for the same
MJD from different data-set epochs are different values, not duplicates.

DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the complete published data set this row was taken
from. Every frames consumer that must agree bit-for-bit records this so
the source is provable rather than assumed.

NUTATION_DPSI_RADIANS.description:
Nutation correction in longitude (dPsi) against the IAU 1980 model,
radians, as published beside the CIP offsets by combined rapid-service
series.

NUTATION_DEPS_RADIANS.description:
Nutation correction in obliquity (dEps) against the IAU 1980 model,
radians.

PROVENANCE.description: Where this Earth-orientation row comes from and the terms it travels under.

RFMOrigin.description:
The point a coordinate system is centred on. Body and barycentre
identifiers are integer ephemeris body codes; text NAME is descriptive
only and is never the machine key.

CELESTIAL_BODY.description: The centre of mass of a single celestial body.

ORBIT_NORMAL.description: Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.
Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.
Orbit normal, RADIAL crossed into VELOCITY.

Axes built by aligning one vector with a reference direction and using a
second vector as a constraint. Vectors are 3-element, expressed in the

RFMCoordinateSystem.description:
A fully specified coordinate system: an axis set, an origin, and the epoch
and time system the axis set is evaluated at. This is the unit a frames
consumer needs; the pre-existing RFMUnion members name an axis convention
alone and cannot express an origin.

Results differ from MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR at the milliarcsecond level and the two are not interchangeable.

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.description: LEGACY, retained and NAMED: true equator of date computed with the IAU-76/FK5 precession-nutation theory. See MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_IERS1996.description: True equator of date computed with the IERS Conventions (1996) reduction (IERS Technical Note 21): IAU 1976 precession, IAU 1980 nutation with the observed celestial pole offsets applied. Distinct from TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5 (no offsets) and TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR (IAU-2006/2000A).

TRUE_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_IERS2003.description: True equator of date computed with the IERS Conventions (2003) reduction (IERS Technical Note 32): IAU 2000A nutation on the IAU 1976 precession with the IAU 2000 precession-rate corrections. The mean-of-date equator under this reduction is MEAN_OF_DATE_EQUATOR_FK5.

TOPOCENTRIC_EAST_NORTH_UP.description: Topocentric East-North-Up axes at a surface site; the site is carried on RFMOrigin. TOPOCENTRIC (20) does not fix the axis order; this does.

TOPOCENTRIC_NORTH_EAST_DOWN.description: Topocentric North-East-Down axes at a surface site.

TOPOCENTRIC_SOUTH_EAST_ZENITH.description: Topocentric South-East-Zenith axes at a surface site.

ORBITAL_VELOCITY_NORMAL_CONORMAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: X along the velocity, Z along the orbit normal, Y completing the right-handed set (VNC). The object is the origin body of the coordinate system.

ORBITAL_RADIAL_TRANSVERSE_NORMAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: X radial (outward), Z along the orbit normal, Y transverse completing the set (RTN, also RSW).

ORBITAL_LOCAL_VERTICAL_LOCAL_HORIZONTAL.description: Orbital axes from the object's state: Z toward the central body (nadir), Y opposite the orbit normal, X completing the set (LVLH).

GALACTIC.description: IAU 1958 Galactic longitude/latitude axes, Hipparcos realization: NGP RA = 192.85948 deg, Dec = +27.12825 deg; l_Omega = 32.93192 deg. ESA SP-1200 (1997), Vol. 1, Section 1.5.3. Cartesian X points to l=0,b=0, Y to l=90,b=0, Z to the north Galactic pole (right-handed). This fixes orientation only, not the origin or the direction of Sgr A*. Explicit Galactocentric parameters select the derived orientation documented on ROLL_DEG; choosing an origin alone never rotates the axes. See Liu, Zhu & Zhang (2011), A&A 526, A16, on the definition and its realization in ICRS; do not substitute a newly fitted Galactic plane.

AXIS_REFERENCE_BODY_ID.description:
Ephemeris body code whose equator/rotation defines the axes, for the
body-referenced axis types. Independent of ORIGIN.

EPOCH.description:
Reference epoch the axis set is evaluated at, ISO 8601. Required for the
of-date and of-epoch axis types; ignored by the inertial ones.

EPOCH_TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time system the EPOCH is expressed in, named by the $TIM timingStandard
member name (for example "UTC", "TAI", "TT", "TDB", "A1").

KERNEL_FRAME_NAME.description: Kernel-declared frame name for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

KERNEL_FRAME_ID.description: Kernel-declared numeric frame id for EPHEMERIS_KERNEL_DEFINED axes.

EOP_DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the Earth-orientation data set used to realise
this system, when the axis chain requires one. Recorded so that two
consumers can prove they used the same table rather than assume it.

GALCEN_RA_DEG.description:
ICRS right ascension of the Galactic center, degrees. NaN means absent.
Sgr A*: 17h45m40.0409s (Reid & Brunthaler 2004, ApJ 616, 872).

GALCEN_DEC_DEG.description:
ICRS declination of the Galactic center, degrees. NaN means absent.
Sgr A*: -29d00m28.118s (Reid & Brunthaler 2004, ApJ 616, 872).

GALCEN_DISTANCE_PC.description:
Sun-to-Galactic-center distance R0, parsecs. NaN means absent.
Example: 8178 pc (GRAVITY Collaboration 2019, A&A 625, L10).

Z_SUN_PC.description:
Solar height above the Galactic midplane, parsecs, positive north.
NaN means absent; example: 20.8 pc (Bennett & Bovy 2019, MNRAS 482, 1417).

ROLL_DEG.description:
Roll angle in degrees in the Astropy Galactocentric convention.
NaN means absent, not zero. With GALACTIC axes, the five explicit scalar
parameters define a derived Galactocentric orientation: X points from
the Sun toward the center's projection in the midplane, Y follows
Galactic rotation, and Z completes a right-handed triad toward Galactic
north. This parameterized orientation is independent of ORIGIN; with
GALACTIC_CENTER the Sun lies at X=-sqrt(R0^2-Z_SUN_PC^2), Y=0, Z=Z_SUN_PC.
All five scalars must be finite for a spatial Galactocentric transform,
with R0 > 0 and abs(Z_SUN_PC) <= R0; none has an assumed default.

V_SUN_KMS.description:
Total solar velocity [v_X,v_Y,v_Z] in km/s in the resulting Galactocentric
axes, including circular motion (not just peculiar U,V,W). Exactly three
components when present; omit the vector when unknown, or use NaN for
an unknown component. A velocity transform requires all three finite.
Schonrich, Binney & Dehnen (2010), MNRAS 403, 1829, constrain peculiar
motion; Reid & Brunthaler (2020), ApJ 892, 39, constrain Sgr A* motion.
Publishers must state their adopted total velocity; no default is implied.

GCRF.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.9 Inertial Earth-centered frame aligned with Earth's center of mass.

ICRF.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.11 International Celestial Reference Frame based on distant quasars.

J2000.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.14 Classical J2000 inertial frame defined at epoch J2000.0.

J2000A.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.15 Updated J2000 frame using IAU2000A precession-nutation models.

EME2000.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.7 Earth Mean Equator frame at epoch J2000 used in orbit determination.

TEMEOFDATE.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.25 True Equator Mean Equinox of Date frame for satellite tracking.

GTOD.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.10 Greenwich True of Date: Earth rotation relative to celestial reference.

CIRS.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.4 Celestial Intermediate Reference System based on CIP and CIO.

MOD_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.18 Mean of Date (MOD) Earth frame using IAU1976 precession.

MOD_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.17 Mean of Date (MOD) celestial body frame evaluated at each epoch.

MOD_MOON.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.19 Mean of Date (MOD) Moon frame evaluated at each epoch.

TOD_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.29 True of Date (TOD) Earth frame with polar motion included.

TOD_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.28 True of Date (TOD) celestial body frame.

TOD_MOON.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.30 True of Date (TOD) Moon frame.

TOE_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.32 True of Epoch (TOE) Earth frame at specific epoch.

TOE_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.31 True of Epoch (TOE) celestial body frame at specific epoch.

TOE_MOON.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.33 True of Epoch (TOE) Moon frame at specific epoch.

EFG.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.6 Earth-Fixed Geocentric frame using geodetic coordinates.

FIXED_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.8 Fixed frame of a celestial body.

FIXED_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.39 Fixed Earth frame aligned with WGS84 ellipsoid.

DTRFYYYY.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.5 Dynamic Terrestrial Reference Frame for a given year (DTRFYYYY).

ALIGN_EARTH.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.2 Mean Earth Equator and Equinox (ALIGN_EARTH) frame.

ALIGN_CB.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.1 Mean Central Body Equator and Equinox (ALIGN_CB) frame.

B1950.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.2.3 Classical Besselian 1950 equator and equinox frame.

EQW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.1 Earth Equatorial Inertial frame aligned with J2000 epoch.

LVLH_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.3 Local Vertical Local Horizontal inertial frame.

LVLH_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.2 Local Vertical Local Horizontal rotating frame.

NSW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.5 Normal along-track cross-track inertial frame.

NSW_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.4 Normal along-track cross-track rotating frame.

NTW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.7 Orbit normal Tangential cross-track inertial frame.

NTW_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.6 Orbit normal Tangential cross-track rotating frame.

PQW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.8 Perifocal frame aligned with orbit's perigee.

RSW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.10 Radial along-track cross-track inertial frame.

RSW_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.9 Radial along-track cross-track rotating frame.

TNW_INERTIAL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.12 Transverse normal cross-track inertial frame.

TNW_ROTATING.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.3.11 Transverse normal cross-track rotating frame.

ECEF.description: Earth-Centered-Earth-Fixed: Rotates with Earth. X-axis at prime meridian, Y eastward, Z towards North Pole.

TEME.description: True Equator Mean Equinox of Date, same as TEMEOFDATE: Dynamic frame for SGP4 satellite tracking.

TEMEOFEPOCH.description: True Equator Mean Equinox of Epoch: Static version of TEMEOFDATE at a given epoch.

ENU.description: East-North-Up: Local tangent plane for surface points.

NED.description: North-East-Down: Aviation/navigation frame aligned with gravity.

NEU.description: North-East-Up: Local tangent plane variant with Up positive.

RIC.description: Radial-Intrack-Cross-track: Spacecraft orientation aligned with orbit.

RTN.description: Radial-Transverse-Normal: Orbit frame for spacecraft dynamics.

VVLH.description: Vehicle-Velocity-Local-Horizontal: Orbit frame aligned with velocity vector.

LTP.description: Local Tangent Plane: Surface-fixed frame centered on a point.

LVLH.description: Local Vertical-Local Horizontal: Z axis towards Earth center, X along velocity.

BRF.description: Body-Fixed Reference Frame: Fixed to a spacecraft or celestial object.

BodyRecordRef.description:
Immutable reference. STANDARD matches REC.standard (e.g. "DTT", no "$"),
or "MODEL" for a manifest. SHA256 is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
Hash exact standalone root bytes WITHOUT size prefix, WITH file identifier;
MODEL hashes exact supplied manifest bytes. Never hash a REC wrapper.
RECORD_ID is the selector specified in docs/clg-contract.md section 2; "root" selects
the complete root. URI is advisory and never fetched by a module.

BodyDescriptor.description:
Shared body descriptor, usable by ACW, CLG and future SCV revisions.
No absence means Earth. Axes retain their FIXED_FRAME X/Y/Z order.
SCVEllipsoid and DTT mapping is normative in docs/clg-contract.md section 2.

NAIF_ID.description: Physical NAIF body, not barycenter; HAS_NAIF_ID required, zero invalid.

SEMI_AXIS_X_M.description: Each axis requires its HAS flag and a finite positive value.

MODEL_SHA256.description: Exact model-manifest bytes, 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

ATMOSPHERE_MODEL_ID.description: Required explicit assertion, "NONE" or a supported model identifier.

TERRAIN.description: Absent means no terrain supplied; elevation remains mandatory for sites.

GRAVITY.description: Optional SHC or MODEL reference; its radius is not the shape radius.

LIGHTING_SPHERE_RADIUS_M.description:
True HAS flag, positive radius and name required for non-ANY lighting.
This is a named spherical-shadow approximation, not ellipsoidal lighting.

HAS_NAIF_ID.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWStateSample.description: Target Cartesian state sample in the required CENTRAL_BODY.FIXED_FRAME.

JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Sample epoch as Julian Date in TT.

VELOCITY_X_MPS.description:
Fixed-frame velocity, meters per second. Required for range-rate,
Doppler and frequency measurements (SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS).

HAS_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

AZIMUTH_RAD.description: Azimuth, radians in the TopocentricFrame convention.

ELEVATION_RAD.description: Minimum visible elevation at the azimuth, radians.

HAS_AZIMUTH_RAD.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWRefractionModel.description: Atmospheric refraction model for apparent-elevation access checks.

HAS_MODEL_KIND.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Interval start as Julian Date in TT.

END_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Interval end as Julian Date in TT.

HAS_START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWGroundStation.description: Ground-station geodetic definition and scheduling constraints.

ALTITUDE_M.description:
Height along the outward normal of CENTRAL_BODY ellipsoid, meters.
docs/clg-contract.md section 4: at height > 0, own-body interior penetration of the
finite segment blocks; tangent contact is clear. At height <= 0, including
zero, use the supporting plane, without an own-ellipsoid intersection test.
The user elevation mask and supplied terrain apply separately at all heights.

MIN_ELEVATION_RAD.description: Explicit minimum visible elevation, radians; HAS flag required.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY.description: Number of simultaneous contacts this station can schedule.

HAS_LATITUDE_RAD.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWConstraint.description: One access constraint. Fields not used by KIND are ignored.

MIN_ELEVATION.description: Observer-to-target elevation at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (ground observers).

MAX_RANGE.description: Observer-to-target range at or below MAX_RANGE_M.

MIN_RANGE.description: Observer-to-target range at or above MIN_RANGE_M.

SUN_EXCLUSION.description: Angle between the observer-to-target and observer-to-Sun directions at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (solar exclusion).

MOON_EXCLUSION.description: Angle between the observer-to-target and observer-to-Moon directions at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (lunar exclusion).

LINE_OF_SIGHT.description: Straight-line visibility between observer and target not occulted by the central body raised by OCCULTATION_ATMOSPHERE_HEIGHT_M (satellite-to-satellite).

OCCULTATION_ATMOSPHERE_HEIGHT_M.description:
Nonnegative meters added to EACH ellipsoid semiaxis for space-to-space
LOS only; not geodetic altitude. Never applied to a surface-station pair.

LABEL.description: Producer label echoed in window attribution.

HAS_KIND.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWConstraintSet.description: A boolean composition of constraints and nested sets.

ANY_OF.description: At least one member must hold (OR).

SETS.description: Nested sets, combined with the same OPERATOR.

HAS_OPERATOR.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWObserverTrajectory.description:
A moving observer (spacecraft) given as pre-sampled central-body-fixed states, in
the same frame and time scale as ACWRequest.STATES.

ACWTargetSignature.description: Observable signature of a simulated target.

DIAMETER_M.description:
Diameter, meters, and geometric albedo of the diffuse sphere that sets
the magnitude, in the band of EOO.MAG (OPTICAL).

EMITTER_FREQUENCY_HZ.description:
Emitter carrier frequency, hertz, and EIRP toward the sensor, dBW
(PASSIVE_RF). A frequency of 0 means the target does not emit.

HAS_RCS_M2.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWTarget.description: One simulated target: truth states and signature.

STATES.description:
Truth central-body-fixed states with velocity, in the frame and time scale of
ACWRequest.STATES.

HAS_NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWSensor.description: A simulated sensor hosted by a ground station or an observer trajectory.

HOST_ID.description:
ACWGroundStation.STATION_ID or ACWObserverTrajectory.OBSERVER_ID of the
host.

RADAR.description: Monostatic radar: range, range rate, two-way Doppler, azimuth, elevation.

OPTICAL.description: Passive optical: right ascension and declination, magnitude.

PASSIVE_RF.description: Passive RF: angles and the received (one-way) frequency of a target's emitter.

ERROR_MODELS.description:
The measurements each observation carries, one error model per
measurement type (noise, bias, bias uncertainty, correlation time,
media and light-time options).

CONSTRAINTS.description:
Visibility for this sensor, the constraints its ACCESS windows were
computed with. When absent, ACWRequest.CONSTRAINTS apply.

OBSERVATION_INTERVAL_S.description: Seconds between observations within a track.

TRACK_DURATION_S.description: Longest track, seconds; 0 tracks the whole access window.

REVISIT_INTERVAL_S.description:
Shortest time between the end of one track of a target and the start
of the following, seconds.

REFERENCE_SNR_DB.description:
RADAR: signal-to-noise ratio, dB, of a REFERENCE_RCS_M2 target at
REFERENCE_RANGE_M; SNR scales with RCS and with range to the -4th power.

DETECTION_THRESHOLD_DB.description: RADAR and PASSIVE_RF: smallest detected signal-to-noise ratio, dB.

RECEIVER_G_OVER_T_DB_PER_K.description: PASSIVE_RF: receiver figure of merit, dB/K, and noise bandwidth, hertz.

LIMITING_MAGNITUDE.description:
OPTICAL: faintest magnitude detected, in the band of EOO.MAG; 0 applies
no magnitude limit.

MAX_HOST_SUN_ELEVATION_RAD.description:
OPTICAL: highest Sun elevation at the host for a detection, radians
(ground-based darkness); requires SUN_STATES. Observations scheduled
in brighter sky are lost.

FALSE_ALARM_RATE_PER_HOUR.description: Uncorrelated detections per hour of tracking, reported with UCT set.

TRANSMIT_FREQUENCY_HZ.description:
RADAR: transmitted carrier frequency, hertz. A DOPPLER error model
measures the echo's two-way shift relative to it, reported as $RDO
DOPPLER with DOPPLER_FREQUENCY set to this value.

HAS_PHENOMENOLOGY.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWSensorAccess.description: Access windows of one sensor to one target (SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS input).

ACWTrack.description: One simulated track: a sensor's scheduled look at a target.

DETECTED_COUNT.description: Observations that passed the detection test and were emitted.

LOSS_REASON.description:
Why scheduled observations were not detected (for example "SNR",
"MAGNITUDE"); empty when all were.

HAS_START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS.description: Compute access windows from pre-sampled target Cartesian states.

SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS.description: Simulate sensor observations of TARGETS by SENSORS: schedule tracks inside the ACCESS windows (computed per sensor and target by COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS with that sensor's constraints), generate each measurement from the truth states with its MEMErrorModel noise and bias, apply the detection test, and add false alarms. The observations are emitted as separate $RDO (RADAR), $EOO (OPTICAL, LASER_RANGING) and $RFO (PASSIVE_RF) records; the result lists the tracks.

COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS_EXPLICIT_BODY.description: Only runtime access operation in body-aware modules; CENTRAL_BODY required.

SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS_EXPLICIT_BODY.description: Only runtime simulation operation in body-aware modules; body required.

STATES.description: Pre-sampled target Cartesian states in CENTRAL_BODY.FIXED_FRAME.

TARGET_STATION_ID.description: Optional target station id. Empty means all stations when supported.

MIN_ELEVATION_OVERRIDE_RAD.description: Optional caller override for minimum elevation, radians.

CONSTRAINTS.description:
Optional constraint composition. When absent the station constraints apply:
every ground station's MIN_ELEVATION_RAD (or the override) plus
ELEVATION_MASK, all required.

OBSERVERS.description:
Optional moving observers (satellite-to-satellite access). Each observer
is evaluated against STATES like a ground station.

DISCRETE.description: Evaluate at the supplied sample epochs only; window edges are samples.

CONTINUOUS.description: Bracket between samples and refine each edge to ROOT_TOLERANCE_S.

ROOT_TOLERANCE_S.description: Edge refinement tolerance for CONTINUOUS, seconds.

SUN_STATES.description:
Sun states in the STATES frame and time scale, required by
SUN_EXCLUSION and TARGET_LIGHTING constraints; interpolated to sample epochs.

MOON_STATES.description: Moon states in the STATES frame and time scale, required by MOON_EXCLUSION.

ACCESS.description:
Where each sensor can see each target (SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS); a pair
without an entry is never observed.

EARTH_ORIENTATION.description:
Earth orientation parameters for celestial directions (right ascension
and declination). When absent, polar motion, UT1-UTC and celestial pole
offsets are zero.

RANDOM_SEED.description:
Seed for measurement noise, biases and false alarms; one seed
reproduces the same observations.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description:
Simulation span as Julian Dates in TT; 0 uses the span of the target
states.

HAS_OPERATION.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Access start as Julian Date in TT.

END_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Access end as Julian Date in TT.

MAX_ELEVATION_RAD.description: Maximum elevation sampled or interpolated during the pass, radians.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description: Number of visible input samples contributing to the window.

OBSERVER_ID.description:
Observer id when the observer is an ACWObserverTrajectory; empty for a
ground station (then STATION_ID names it).

START_LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_INDEX.description:
Index into the flattened, depth-first constraint list of the constraint
whose transition opens the window. A clipped start has no limiting
constraint: HAS_START_LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_INDEX is false. A present
index is nonnegative and in range; the retained wire default is not a sentinel.

END_LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_INDEX.description:
Index of the constraint whose transition closes the window. A clipped end
has HAS_END_LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_INDEX false. A present index is nonnegative
and in range; the retained wire default is not a sentinel.

START_LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_LABEL.description: Labels of those constraints, when the producer set them.

MIN_RANGE_M.description: Range extrema over the window, meters.

EDGES_REFINED.description: True when edges were root-refined (CONTINUOUS); false when they are samples.

HAS_START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

ACWResult.description: Result for one access-window compute request.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite, or numerically invalid.

UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.description: The requested operation is not supported by the module.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

DISCRETE.description: Evaluate at the supplied sample epochs only; window edges are samples.

CONTINUOUS.description: Bracket between samples and refine each edge to ROOT_TOLERANCE_S.

CONSTRAINT_LABELS.description: Flattened depth-first constraint list the window indices refer to.

HAS_STATUS.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

CENTRAL_BODY.description:
Appended slot 2. Mandatory in every new request and successful result.
Request OPERATION must be 3 (access) or 4 (simulation); old modules reject
these codes. Missing body fails acw-body-required; absence never means
Earth. Operations 1/2 are archival only and are rejected by new runtimes.
Result must echo the exact descriptor field values, including optional
presence; requester rejects a missing/different echo. Raw table offsets
are not identity. Explicit one-time archive conversion is outside runtime.

SCVAzElMaskPoint.description:
One point of an azimuth/elevation mask: the lowest elevation at which the
sensor sees at that azimuth (a terrain or structure horizon). The mask is the
polyline through its points ordered by AZIMUTH_DEG, wrapping from the last
point to the first across 360 degrees, linearly interpolated in azimuth.

AZIMUTH_DEG.description: Azimuth, degrees clockwise from north, in [0, 360).

MIN_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Minimum visible elevation at AZIMUTH_DEG, degrees above the local horizontal.

SCVSensorShapeContract.description:
The field-of-view shape of one sensor. $SCV carries it in SCVSensor; $SNR
carries the same table as the sensor definition's FIELD_OF_VIEW, so a
definition and an analysis request never describe a shape in two types.

AZ_EL_MASK.description:
Azimuth/elevation mask of a ground sensor, empty when the sensor has none.
Clips the shape: a direction below the mask is outside the field of view.

CLGRecordRef.description: Same identity/hash rules as BodyRecordRef, docs/clg-contract.md section 2.

POSITION_ERROR_M.description: HAS_<FIELD> controls presence; applicable bounds must be finite >=0.

HAS_CATEGORY.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

MOTION_SOURCE_INDEX.description:
Missing HAS_MOTION_SOURCE_INDEX is allowed only with explicitly supplied
FRAME_STATIONARY=true and exact identity
with the definition's fixed frame. Otherwise a valid source is required.

SPACE_SPACE_SKIM_MARGIN_M.description:
Presence flag required; finite >=0, added to EACH semiaxis only when BOTH
endpoints are SPACECRAFT. BodyDescriptor always describes true surface.

HAS_MOTION_SOURCE_INDEX.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

BODY_INDEX.description: All indices require their HAS flag; -1 remains an invalid wire default.

SITE_POSITION_M.description: Stations: Cartesian fixed-frame meters and ellipsoid-normal unit up.

ELEVATION_GATE.description: Stations require MIN_ELEVATION; spacecraft require NONE and absent angle.

ATTITUDE_LAW.description: Stations require STATION_ENU. Spacecraft explicitly select one other law.

FIXED_ATTITUDE.description: Required only for INERTIALLY_FIXED, node -> declared inertial frame.

HAS_CATEGORY.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

SHAPE.description:
Mount +Z boresight, +X right, +Y up. SCV angles are degrees.
Shape radial fields zero; bounds below are authoritative SI values.

MAX_SLEW_RATE_RAD_S.description: MECHANICAL only: finite positive rates/acceleration with true HAS flags.

ACQUISITION_TIME_S.description: MECHANICAL only: finite >=0; explicit zero has a true HAS flag.

MAX_POINT_AHEAD_RAD.description:
Bidirectional retarded COMMON_AXIS requires finite positive separation
tolerance stated by user, backed by DEFINITION_REFS. No implied zero.
Retarded COMMON_AXIS profiles require positive value even in a one-way run.

HAS_MEDIUM.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

INITIAL_DIRECTION.description: Mechanical initial direction; fixed beam requires exactly mount +Z.

HAS_NODE_INDEX.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

DIRECTION.description:
Required service direction relative to canonical endpoint identities,
never relative to arrival/storage order; docs/clg-contract.md section 4.

REQUESTED_TIME_ACCURACY_S.description: No default is a valid tolerance. Every applicable value is explicit.

ATTITUDE_JOIN_TOLERANCE_RAD.description: Normalized-rotation continuity: geodesic angle and angular derivatives.

EMIT_EVENT_SNAPSHOTS.description: Required explicit opt-in/out; HAS_EMIT_EVENT_SNAPSHOTS must be true.

MAX_WORKING_BYTES.description: Resource bounds require true HAS flags and finite positive values.

HAS_TIMING.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

EPOCH_JD_TT_DAY.description: Two-part JD TT, integer noon-based day plus seconds [0,86400).

START_OFFSET_S.description:
ALL offsets incl. source halos satisfy abs(offset)<2^22 seconds.
Longer analyses split/re-epoch definitions; never use year-long doubles.

WORKING_FRAME.description:
SIMULTANEOUS may use fixed axes. RETARDED requires SSB/ICRF inertial
coordinates or a declared constant-velocity inertial transform thereof.
GCRS-like local approximation needs certified model error; rotating
body-fixed axes and a moving body center are not inertial ray coordinates.

NODES.description:
Dense index = vector position; ascending exact UTF-8 NODE_ID bytes.
Immutable for the graph, including all state blocks and result chunks.

TERMINALS.description: Ascending (NODE_INDEX, exact UTF-8 TERMINAL_ID bytes); unique IDs.

HAS_EPOCH_JD_TT_DAY.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

CLGPoseSegment.description:
u=(t-START_S)/(STOP_S-START_S), ascending power coefficients axis-major.
Position length=3*(DEGREE+1), SI. Quaternion length=4*(DEGREE+1), xyzw,
required for bodies and SUPPLIED_SERIES nodes; absent for evaluated laws.
Q/||Q|| defines rotation. Sign-continuous representative, normalized C2
rotation and angular derivatives checked using explicit join tolerances.

HAS_OWNER.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

HAS_SEQUENCE.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

CLGPair.description:
A is the endpoint with the lexicographically smaller (NODE_ID,TERMINAL_ID)
exact UTF-8 byte tuple, B the larger; distinct nodes, canonical A<B indexes.
Reversed fields or noncanonical dictionaries fail, never reverse direction.
Sorted by (A,B,DIRECTION); requested direction only.

CLGCause.description:
All co-causes retained, sorted by enum ordinal, ray direction, body index.
BODY_INDEX supplied for OCCULTATION, HORIZON_A/B and TERRAIN_A/B only.
No ambiguous zero body.

CLGRayTimes.description:
One demanded ray at an interval boundary, TT offsets from graph epoch.
Emission equals boundary OFFSET_S. Reception bracket encloses the mapped
emission bracket and light-time solve error; SIMULTANEOUS uses equal times.

CLGBoundary.description:
Local to a result chunk. Distinct event clusters never merged by tolerance.
Certified root brackets overlap only for a proved common event, otherwise
refine to disjoint brackets or fail. A common event retains every cause.

OFFSET_S.description: Emission clock for every demanded ray, including both duplex rays.

RAY_TIMES.description: Exactly the demanded direction(s), A_TO_B before B_TO_A; no duplicates.

HAS_OFFSET_S.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

CLGInterval.description:
START/STOP/READY_FROM are emission TT offsets (docs/clg-contract.md section 3a).
Packed scalars are present iff HAS_VALUES=true, otherwise invalid.
READY_FROM_S is present iff HAS_READY_FROM=true (no silent zero readiness).

TIME_S.description:
Physical scheduling event in TT. ACTIVE/DRAIN bound emission service;
retarded RELEASE follows the latest demanded reception, including tails.

EPOCH_S.description: Common emission query in TT; equal-time transitions already applied.

ROW_OFFSETS.description: Exactly N+1 entries, starting zero and ending at arc count.

NEIGHBOR_NODE_INDEXES.description: One outgoing arc per directed ACTIVE link, two per bidirectional link.

RANGES_M.description:
Parallel to arcs; computed natively for that directed ray at EPOCH_S.
SIMULTANEOUS: same-epoch range and range/c; reception epoch equals EPOCH_S.
RETARDED: null-path range, coordinate vacuum flight time, reception TT.

HAS_EPOCH_S.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

CLGProvenance.description: Module-known values only; host identity is separate PVN on CLGResult.

STATE_BLOCK_SHA256.description: One 64-character lowercase hex digest per block in sequence order.

MODEL_ERROR_BOUND_S.description:
Mandatory, >= max compatible range/c for SIMULTANEOUS, and increased
when needed to bound actual model discrepancy; interbody simultaneous fails.

HAS_ROOT_ERROR_BOUND_S.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

PAIRS.description: Global dictionaries in chunk zero only, bounded to 64 MiB together.

BOUNDARIES.description: Each interval and its boundary records live together in exactly one chunk.

TOPOLOGY_CHANGE_EPOCHS_S.description:
Sorted unique TT emission epochs where the directed (src,dst,link) set
changes after atomic transitions; always includes START_OFFSET_S.
Each has a mandatory adjacency, independent of EMIT_EVENT_SNAPSHOTS.
Chunk-local entries correspond to this chunk's snapshots; concatenate.

PRODUCER.description: Host stamps PRODUCER_SHA256 from loaded artifact before durable COMPLETE.

HAS_STATUS.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.

CLG.description:
Exactly one payload; every frame uses the same GRAPH_ID. COMPLETE requires
all chunks, definition, implemented scope/enums and host-stamped producer.

GRAPH_ID.description:
Globally unique across exchanging producers/stores; names one dictionary
forever. A known ID with a different definition SHA256 is rejected,
never merged or rebound. docs/clg-contract.md section 2 defines allocation and hashing.

HAS_PAYLOAD.description: Value presence: false means omitted; true precedes value validation.
